comment: Turns the published security.txt file on or off.
modal: When set to **Yes**, the store publishes a `security.txt` file (under `/.well-known/`) describing how security researchers should report issues. Can be set per website.

comment: The security contact email address published in security.txt.
modal: The email address researchers should use to report security issues; it is listed as a Contact entry in the published `security.txt`. Can differ per website.

comment: The security contact phone number published in security.txt.
modal: A phone number researchers can use to report security issues; it is listed as a Contact entry in the published `security.txt`. Can differ per website.

comment: The URL of your security policy, published in security.txt; must be a secure (HTTPS) URL.
modal: The address of your vulnerability-disclosure or security policy page, published as the Policy entry in `security.txt`. The value must be a secure (HTTPS) URL. Can differ per website.

comment: The signature used to sign the published security.txt file.
modal: Optional signature text associated with the `security.txt` file, letting researchers verify its authenticity. Can differ per website.
